source: Nnghh…
Damn, my whole body hurts… We got too wild last night…
translation: 该死，我全身都疼……我们昨晚玩得太疯了……

source: And it looks like Goro cleaned up after me, too…
translation: 而且看来Goro也替我收拾好了……

source: Hold on a second…
translation: 等一下……

source: Where’s Goro and Aiden…?
translation: Goro和Aiden去哪儿了……？

source: Goodness… I think I woke up way too late…
translation: 天啊……我想我起得太晚了……

source: Maybe they already headed to work…?
translation: 也许他们已经去工作了……？

source: Where’s Goro?
translation: Goro在哪儿？

source: Maybe he started working in the office…?
translation: 也许他已经在办公室开始工作了……？

source: *sigh* I knew it was a bad idea to drink yesterday…
translation: *叹气* 我就知道昨天喝酒是个坏主意……

source: He must’ve tried waking me but I was too hungover to notice.
translation: 他一定试过叫醒我，但我宿醉得太厉害，没有察觉。

source: All this booze is way out of character for me… I’ve been getting loose and careless since Goro’s been spoiling me.
translation: 喝这么多酒实在不像我……自从Goro一直宠着我，我就变得放松又大意。

source: Wait… Maybe this is a test of my punctuality…?
translation: 等等……也许这是对我守时性的考验……？

source: G-Gah! I better suit up and report in…!
translation: 啊、啊！我最好赶紧穿好衣服去报到……！

source: S-Sorry, I’m late! I was—
translation: 对、对不起，我迟到了！我——

source: H-Huh…? He’s not here either?
translation: 啊、啊……？他也不在这里？

source: He must be outside then. Today’s the day we resume work, after all.
translation: 那他一定在外面。毕竟今天是我们恢复工作的日子。

source: Ah, Yoshi!
translation: 啊，Yoshi！

source: Good morning, Yuri!
translation: 早上好，Yuri！

source: Where’s Dad?! The workers just arrived!
translation: 爸爸在哪儿？！工人刚到了！

source: Huh…? I thought he was outside already.
translation: 嗯……？我以为他已经在外面了。

source: Wait, he isn’t here? I thought he’d be with you!
translation: 等等，他不在这里？我以为他会和你在一起！

source: Unfortunately, not…
translation: 很遗憾，没有……

source: *sigh* I didn’t receive any instructions from him… He usually takes care of this stuff.
translation: *叹气* 我没有收到他的任何指示……通常这些事都是他负责。

source: Did you check if he’s in the mess hall? Maybe he’s having his coffee.
translation: 你检查过他是否在食堂吗？也许他在喝咖啡。

source: No, I was there cleaning up with Aiden and Emilia earlier. He told me he last saw Dad in here…
translation: 没有，我早些时候和Aiden、Emilia在那里收拾。他说他最后一次看到爸爸是在这里……

source: Hmm… He must not be at camp then…
translation: 嗯……那他一定不在营地……

source: I tried calling him and his phone was just ringing… Maybe he’s in a meeting?
translation: 我试着给他打电话，手机只是一直响……也许他在开会？

source: I don’t remember there being an appointment on his schedule.
translation: 我不记得他的日程表上有预约。

source: That’s weird… Where could Dad be? And how are we gonna handle everything today?
translation: 真奇怪……爸爸会在哪里？我们今天该怎么处理一切？

source: That’s weird… Where could Dad be? And how are we gonna handle everything today?{fast}
translation: 真奇怪……爸爸会在哪里？我们今天该怎么处理一切？{fast}

source: Only Goro knows what to do.
translation: 只有Goro知道该怎么做。

source: I’m not sure… And he’s the only one who knows how to lead the project…
translation: 我不确定……而且他是唯一知道如何领导项目的人……

source: We have to wait for him to get back before doing anything.
translation: 我们必须等他回来再做任何事。

source: I don’t think that’s gonna work… We need to address the workers before they can start.
translation: 我不觉得那行得通……工人开工前，我们需要先向他们说明。

source: Maybe you can do it, Yoshi?
translation: 也许你可以做，Yoshi？

source: A-Alright, I’ll handle it until Goro gets back.
translation: 好、好吧，在Goro回来前我会处理。

source: We should wait for Goro.
translation: 我们应该等Goro。

source: I’m not sure… Maybe we should wait for him before doing anything?
translation: 我不确定……也许我们该等他回来再做任何事？

source: I'll take over for now.
translation: 我暂时接手。

source: I’m not sure, but it’s probably important, so we’ll just have to handle it for now.
translation: 我不确定，但这可能很重要，所以我们只能暂时处理它。

source: I’ll take over and brief everyone.
translation: 我会接手并向大家说明。

source: Goro's counting on us.
translation: Goro指望着我们。

source: I’m not sure, but Goro trusts us to handle things while he’s away.
translation: 我不确定，但Goro相信我们能在他不在时处理好事情。

source: Whatever he’s doing is probably important, so I’ll cover for him and brief everyone.
translation: 无论他在做什么，可能都很重要，所以我会替他顶上并向大家说明。

source: Thanks, Yoshi! you’re a lifesaver! The workers should be waiting at the site with Lloyd and Darius!
translation: 谢谢，Yoshi！你真是救星！工人应该正和Lloyd、Darius在现场等着！

source: Got it! I’ll head there right away!
translation: 明白！我马上过去！

source: —and that should cover the rest of the project timeline.
translation: ——这应该涵盖项目剩余的时间安排。

source: If you need any further clarifications on your tasks or schedules, please refer to Architect Sirius and Foreman Najjar for more details!
translation: 如果你们需要进一步明确任务或日程，请向建筑师Sirius和工头Najjar了解更多细节！

source: Dismissed!
translation: 解散！

source: Ah, hey guys. Sorry about the slight delay.
translation: 啊，嘿，各位。抱歉稍微晚了点。

source: We couldn’t find Sir Goro this morning. He must’ve had to attend something urgent.
translation: 我们今天早上找不到Goro先生。他一定是不得不处理什么紧急事情。

source: Yeah, and he had the updated schedule, so we couldn’t start.
translation: 是啊，而且更新后的日程在他那里，所以我们没法开始。

source: Good thing you have it with you, Yoshi.
translation: 幸好你带着它，Yoshi。

source: Oh, yeah. I know where to find the agenda documents, so I figured I’d take over.
translation: 哦，是啊。我知道在哪里能找到议程文件，所以我想我来接手。

source: What brings you two scouts here, anyways?
translation: 不过，你们两个童子军为什么来这里？

source: Well, we’re planning to help with the work.
translation: 嗯，我们打算帮忙工作。

source: Taiga’s quite an aspiring carpenter.
translation: Taiga是个很有志向的木匠。

source: Hey! I didn’t sign up for this! You said we’re gonna blow some snow!
translation: 嘿！我可没报名干这个！你说我们要去吹雪！

source: There’s barely any left, you dummy.
translation: 几乎没剩多少了，你这个笨蛋。

source: A-Anyway, Yoshi! We need to talk to you about something…!
translation: 总、总之，Yoshi！我们得和你谈一件事……！

source: Ah, what is it?
translation: 啊，什么事？

source: Well, we’ve stumbled on a little problem… The storm from before destroyed some of the raw materials that weren’t properly stored…
translation: 嗯，我们遇到一个小问题……之前的暴风雪毁掉了一些没有妥善存放的原材料……

source: Oh no…
translation: 哦不……

source: We have enough to last for a little while still, but it looks like we need to order more to cover what we lost.
translation: 我们暂时还有够用的材料，但看来需要订购更多来补上损失。

source: We already had spare materials in case of something like this to be safe, but most of that was used on the repairs yesterday.
translation: 为防范这种情况，我们原本已有备用材料，但其中大部分昨天都用在修缮上了。

source: A-Ah, I see.
translation: 啊、啊，我明白了。

source: Sorry for causing you trouble first thing in the morning, Yoshi…
translation: 一大早就给你添麻烦了，Yoshi……

source: It’s alright, it can’t be helped. I assume we need a budget approval to order these?
translation: 没关系，这也没办法。我想订购这些需要预算批准？

source: Y-Yes! We prepared this billing estimate for all the materials!
translation: 是、是的！我们为所有材料准备了这份费用估算！

source: We just need a review and signature from Sir Goro and we’ll take care of the rest.
translation: 我们只需要 Goro先生 审核并签字，剩下的就由我们处理。

source: But since he’s not here right now, we can’t really proceed…
translation: 但他现在不在，我们确实没法继续……

source: Well, I can sign them for now! I’ll just run it by him as soon as he gets back!
translation: 嗯，我现在可以替他签！等他一回来我就立刻让他过目！

source: Oh, that’d be great if you can!
translation: 哦，如果你能这么做就太好了！

source: I know it’s not the standard policy, but sometimes we gotta bend the rules a little, don’t we?
translation: 我知道这不符合标准规定，但有时我们也得稍微变通一下，对吧？

source: Hehe… Now you sound like a real contractor…
translation: 嘿嘿……你现在听起来像个真正的承包商了……

source: Who’s this guy and what did you do to the old, boring sheriff?
translation: 这家伙是谁，你把那个老气又无聊的治安官怎么了？

source: Here’s the list!
translation: 这是清单！

source: Everything seems to be in order… And I don’t think we even need to ask Mr. Clermont for more funding, either.
translation: 一切看起来都没问题……而且我想我们甚至不需要向 Clermont先生 再要资金。

source: Oh?
translation: 哦？

source: We already allocated funds for situations like this. We’ll just use them!
translation: 我们已经为这种情况划拨了资金。直接用就行！

source: Here you go, Lloyd. Signed and approved.
translation: 给你，Lloyd。已签字批准。

source: Wow, thanks~!
translation: 哇，谢谢～！

source: I gotta say, Yoshi. You’ve gotten really good at this over the last few months.
translation: 我得说，Yoshi。过去几个月里，你真的越来越擅长这个了。

source: Yes. Every day, you’re becoming more and more like a leader.
translation: 是的。你每天都越来越像一名领导者。

source: Yes. Every day, you’re becoming more and more like a leader.{fast}
translation: 是的。你每天都越来越像一名领导者。{fast}

source: I have no choice but to step in.
translation: 我别无选择，只能挺身而出。

source: Well, Goro is counting on me to run this place one day.
translation: 嗯，Goro 指望着有一天由我来经营这里。

source: I’m following Goro’s footsteps.
translation: 我在追随 Goro 的脚步。

source: Haha, I’m just doing what Goro would.
translation: 哈哈，我只是在做 Goro 会做的事。

source: I’ve got to meet his expectations if I’m going to run this place one day.
translation: 如果有一天我要经营这里，就得达到他的期望。

source: I don’t want to take all the credit.
translation: 我不想独揽全部功劳。

source: Ahehe, I can’t take all the credit, though.
translation: 啊哈哈，不过我不能独揽全部功劳。

source: Goro’s the one who taught me how to handle this kind of stuff.
translation: 是 Goro 教我如何处理这种事。

source: I’m only applying what I learned.
translation: 我只是在运用所学。

source: Ahehe, I learned from the best, and I’m only applying it.
translation: 啊哈哈，我向最优秀的人学习，只是在运用所学。

source: After working with him throughout the project, I’ve been trying to absorb all that knowledge and think like him too.
translation: 在整个项目中和他一起工作后，我一直在努力吸收那些知识，也试着像他一样思考。

source: Hmph, took you long enough! Spending all that time with the old geezer is finally paying off.
translation: 哼，你总算学会了！花那么多时间和那个老头待在一起终于有回报了。

source: You actually sounded tough when you were doing all that serious talk a while ago – it’s way different from your lame, dorky-ass self!
translation: 你刚才说那些严肃话时听起来真的很强硬——和你那个逊毙了的书呆子样完全不同！

source: So, you’re saying Yoshi is… cool?
translation: 所以，你是说 Yoshi……很酷？

source: Don’t put words in my mouth, Dynamite!
translation: 别把话塞进我嘴里，Dynamite！

source: Wh-What…? Really?
translation: 什、什么……？真的？

source: Wait… do you need anything from me, Yoichi?
translation: 等等……Yoichi，你需要我做什么吗？

source: No! I’m just saying...! Don’t make such a big deal outta it!
translation: 不！我只是说说……！别把它看得那么夸张！

source: Aww~ I appreciate it, Yoichi.
translation: 啊～我很感激，Yoichi。

source: It’s not ALL good though, you just went from dad to grandpa energy.
translation: 不过也不全是好事，你只是从爸爸气质变成爷爷气质了。

source: *sigh* And I thought I was finally getting a compliment from you, Yoichi…
translation: *叹气* 我还以为终于能从 Yoichi 那里得到称赞了……

source: Anyway, I guess we got all that we need for now! I’ll call the suppliers and they should be able to deliver by sundown!
translation: 总之，我想我们暂时需要的东西都齐了！我会打给供应商，他们应该能在日落前送到！

source: If anything comes up again, don’t hesitate to ask me, alright?
translation: 如果又有什么事，别犹豫，尽管来找我，好吗？

source: Aye, aye! Captain!
translation: 遵命！船长！

source: Come with me, scouts. Let’s get crafting.
translation: 跟我来，童子军们。我们开始制作吧。

source: Sweet! I’m ready for some woodworking!
translation: 太好了！我准备好做点木工活了！

source: Not me! I’m into a different kind of woodworking! Later, dorks!
translation: 我才不！我喜欢另一种“木工”！回头见，书呆子们！

source: Hey, get back here!
translation: 嘿，回来！

source: Let him be, Taiga. He’ll come back.
translation: 随他去吧，Taiga。他会回来的。

source: But it might be best if he doesn’t…
translation: 不过他最好别回来……

source: Alright, that takes care of this department. I might as well check on the others.
translation: 好，这个部门的事处理完了。我不如去看看其他部门。

source: Emilia, where’s the lamb sauce?!
translation: Emilia，羊肉酱在哪儿？！

source: I’m coming, I’m coming! What do you think this is? Hell’s kitchen?!
translation: 来了，来了！你以为这是哪里？地狱厨房吗？！

source: Oh hello, Aiden! And… Emilia…?
translation: 哦，你好，Aiden！还有……Emilia……？

source: What’s with that look, Yoshi?
translation: 你那表情是怎么回事，Yoshi？

source: A-Ahehe… I’m just not used to seeing you working in the kitchen.
translation: 啊、啊哈哈……我只是不习惯看到你在厨房工作。

source: I know, right? She suddenly came in and offered to help with today’s lunch service!
translation: 就是啊，对吧？她突然进来，提出帮忙今天的午餐服务！

source: Well, I already finished making all the beds in the workers’ cabins, and the laundry’s already running, so I might as well make myself useful.
translation: 嗯，我已经铺好了工人小屋的所有床铺，洗衣机也已经在运转，所以我不如让自己派上用场。

source: Hehe~ Isn’t she sweet? This is much better than you were playing the villain!
translation: 嘿嘿～她不是很贴心吗？这比你扮演反派时好多了！

source: Don’t get the wrong idea. I thought it’d be nice to learn how to cook, and since you needed help, it was mutually beneficial.
translation: 别误会。我觉得学做饭会不错，而既然你需要帮忙，这对双方都有好处。

source: Really? You seem more of a food critic than a chef to me...
translation: 真的？在我看来，你更像美食评论家而不是厨师……

source: Hmph! I’m way past being a rich snob!
translation: 哼！我早就不是那个势利的有钱人了！

source: Hahaha! You sure?
translation: 哈哈哈！你确定？

source: Anyway, it’s something that I wish my parents had taught me. Or anyone for that matter.
translation: 总之，这是我希望父母曾教过我的东西。或者说任何人教过都行。

source: For most of my life I lived with maids doing everything for me, and I didn’t have the chance to learn anything useful.
translation: 我人生的大部分时间都由女仆替我做一切，没有机会学任何有用的东西。

source: So, when I got cut off from that lifestyle, I realized I don’t really know anything at all.
translation: 所以，当我被切断那种生活方式后，我意识到自己其实什么都不懂。

source: I had the chance to learn some of that when I was here as a scout, but I didn’t realize how important it was.
translation: 我以前在这里当童子军时有机会学到一些，但没有意识到它有多重要。

source: Well, as long as you have the drive, it’s never too late to learn!
translation: 嗯，只要你有动力，学习永远不晚！

source: Yeah, and you’re doing great! You’ve taken a lot of work off my plate with all the stirring and washing!
translation: 是啊，而且你做得很棒！你搅拌和清洗，替我分担了很多工作！

source: Eugh, I didn’t know I was going to get this gross and sweaty from all of this though… Why did I wear white?!
translation: 呃，不过我不知道做这些会让我变得这么脏、这么汗湿……我为什么穿白色？！

source: I told you it was gonna be hot in here! Just do like me!
translation: 我告诉过你这里会很热！就像我一样做！

source: Okay, now that sounds like the Emilia we know…
translation: 好吧，这才像我们认识的 Emilia……

source: Hey! How else was I supposed to react to that?!
translation: 嘿！不然我该怎么反应？！

source: Anyway~ What brings you here, Yoshi? Food’s not ready for another hour or two!
translation: 总之～Yoshi，你来这里做什么？食物还要一两个小时才好！

source: Ah, I was just doing the rounds to see if everything’s going well.
translation: 啊，我只是在巡查，看看一切是否顺利。

source: Also, I figured kitchen work would be pretty hectic, since there’s plenty of workers to feed again. So, I came by to help!
translation: 而且，我觉得厨房工作会相当忙乱，因为又有很多工人要吃饭。所以我过来帮忙！

source: Yeah, totally! We could use some more hands around here!
translation: 是啊，当然！我们这里可以多些人手！

source: Here, you can chop these veggies that Aiden needed. I can’t leave my station since this stew needs to be stirred constantly.
translation: 来，你帮Aiden把这些蔬菜切了吧。这锅炖菜得一直搅，我走不开。

source: Anyway, I heard that Sir Goro has gone missing today? Is that true?
translation: 总之，我听说Goro先生今天不见了，是真的吗？

source: Ah, yeah… He wasn’t in the office when I woke up.
translation: 啊，是啊……我醒来时他不在办公室。

source: Oh right! That’s why you had to do the announcement thingy a while ago…
translation: 哦，对！所以你刚才才得做那个公告的事……

source: I’ll be honest, I was winging the whole thing. I just repeated the same stuff Goro said during the previous meetings.
translation: 老实说，整件事我都是临场发挥。我只是重复了 Goro 在之前会议上说过的话。

source: Either way, you handled the situation quite well if I do say so myself. I didn’t see you have any problems taking charge.
translation: 不管怎么说，你处理得相当不错。接手工作时一点也没出问题。

source: Might as well call Yoshi ‘Mr. Future President’, eh?
translation: 那干脆叫Yoshi“Mr. Future President”吧，怎么样？

source: Ah, well… I’m only taking over while he’s gone…
translation: 啊，嗯……我只是在他不在时暂时接管……

source: It is pretty strange for him to be absent like that without any warning.
translation: 他这样毫无预警地缺席确实很奇怪。

source: He probably had to take care of something else more important.
translation: 他可能不得不去处理其他更重要的事。

source: That doesn’t add up. What else is more important than Camp Buddy to him?
translation: 这说不通。对他来说，还有什么比 Camp Buddy 更重要？

source: Oh! Maybe it’s kinda like a test to see if Yoshi can handle being in charge for the day?
translation: 哦！也许这有点像测试，看看 Yoshi 能不能负责一天？

source: Kinda like a secret initiation!
translation: 有点像秘密入门仪式！

source: I doubt someone like him would do something silly like that…
translation: 我怀疑像他这样的人会做这种傻事……

source: Yeah, but he’s told Yoshi a ton of times before that he’ll make him head of the camp once he retires!
translation: 是啊，但他以前很多次告诉 Yoshi，等自己退休后会让 Yoshi 领导营地！

source: You think you have what it takes, Yoshi?
translation: Yoshi，你觉得自己有这个能力吗？

source: You think you have what it takes, Yoshi?{fast}
translation: Yoshi，你觉得自己有这个能力吗？{fast}

source: I have to prove myself first.
translation: 我必须先证明自己。

source: I have to prove myself to him first.
translation: 我必须先向他证明自己。

source: Only Goro would know when it’s time.
translation: 只有 Goro 知道什么时候才是合适时机。

source: I'm not sure if I even want that.
translation: 我甚至不确定自己是否想要那个。

source: Honestly, I’m not sure that I even want that…
translation: 说实话，我不确定自己是否真的想要那个……

source: Goro has so much responsibility, and taking it on myself is intimidating...
translation: Goro 承担着那么多责任，自己接过来让我感到畏惧……

source: I'd rather Goro stick around.
translation: 我宁愿 Goro 留在这里。

source: Honestly, I’d rather Goro stick around and work together.
translation: 说实话，我宁愿 Goro 留在这里，一起工作。

source: He handles so much and does it all so well. I’m content to keep assisting him for now.
translation: 他处理那么多事，而且每件都做得很好。我满足于暂时继续协助他。

source: I would rather us lead together.
translation: 我更希望我们一起领导。

source: Honestly, I’d rather stay by his side than take over.
translation: 说实话，比起接管，我更愿意留在他身边。

source: If we work together, then we can share the burden and grow as partners.
translation: 如果我们一起工作，就能分担负担，并作为伙伴共同成长。

source: My goodness, Yoshinori! That’s not a very ambitious mindset!
translation: 天啊，Yoshinori！这可不是很有抱负的心态！

source: You underestimate yourself far too much – you have the skills and charisma needed to lead the entire camp if you wanted to.
translation: 你太低估自己了——如果你愿意，你拥有领导整个营地所需的技能和魅力。

source: Hehe, just look at Emilia, she almost got away with being our manager~
translation: 嘿嘿，看看 Emilia，她差点就成功当上我们的经理了～

source: *ehem* My point is, Sir Goro isn’t going to be here forever – at some point, he’s going to want to take it easy.
translation: *咳哼* 我想说的是，Goro先生 不会永远在这里——总有一天，他会想轻松下来。

source: After all, it’s been what…? A decade since this place started? You’re going to have to step up eventually!
translation: 毕竟，这里开办多久了……？十年？你终究得站出来！

source: Hmmm…
Chill, Emilia. I’m sure there’s plenty of time for Yoshi to think about all that!
translation: 放轻松，Emilia。我相信还有很多时间让 Yoshi 思考这些！

source: R-Right. I wasn’t trying to be overbearing. I just thought you should know, Sir Goro ought to be proud to one day leave this place to you.
translation: 对、对。我并不是想强迫你。我只是觉得你该知道，有一天 Goro先生 把这里交给你时，应该会感到自豪。

source: Th-Thanks, Emilia…
translation: 谢、谢谢，Emilia……

source: Anyway! I think we’re done with the chopping! That should be all the prep work we need help with, all that’s left is the actual cooking!
translation: 总之！我想我们切完了！这应该就是我们需要帮忙的所有准备工作，剩下的只是实际烹饪！

source: You can get back to doing your management stuff while Gramps is gone, Yoshi! Thanks for the help!
translation: 趁Gramps不在，你可以回去做管理工作了，Yoshi！谢谢帮忙！

source: Okay, then! There’s just one last department I have to check!
translation: 好，那就这样！我只剩最后一个部门要检查！

source: I’ll be at the office if you guys need me, alright?
translation: 如果你们需要我，我会在办公室，好吗？

source: Gotcha! See ya, Yoshi!
translation: 明白！回见，Yoshi！

source: Come in~!
translation: 进来～！

source: Hey there, Yuri, Jin!
translation: 嘿，Yuri、Jin！

source: Hi, Yoshi! For a second, I thought Dad had come back.
translation: 嗨，Yoshi！刚才一瞬间，我还以为爸爸回来了。

source: Umm… I hope you don’t mind us using Sir Goro’s computer here, Yoshi…
translation: 嗯……希望你不介意我们在这里使用 Goro先生 的电脑，Yoshi……

source: Not at all! What are you up to?
translation: 完全不介意！你们在做什么？

source: Well, this morning, the workers and I set up cameras around the camp based on Yuri’s recommendations.
translation: 嗯，今天早上，工人和我根据 Yuri 的建议在营地周围安装了摄像头。

source: Now we’re just connecting them all to the network and making sure they’re working properly.
translation: 现在我们只是在把它们都连到网络上，并确保正常工作。

source: Oh, wow! I can’t believe we have security cameras now!
translation: 哦，哇！我不敢相信我们现在有安保摄像头了！

source: Finally, right?! Now, nothing can escape my eyes!
translation: 终于，对吧？！现在，没有什么能逃过我的眼睛！

source: Th-That’s kinda creepy, Yuri…
translation: 这、这有点吓人，Yuri……

source: What?! I meant bullying, Yoshi! What were you even thinking?!
translation: 什么？！我指的是欺凌，Yoshi！你到底在想什么？！

source: *ehem* Anyway, are they working, Jin?
translation: *咳哼* 总之，它们能正常工作吗，Jin？

source: Yep! We have ten connected so far, mostly around the perimeter and activity areas.
translation: 能！到目前为止我们连上了十个，主要布置在周边和活动区域。

source: For example… we have one in the mess hall… the campgrounds… entrance… and here at the office!
translation: 例如……我们在食堂……营地……入口……还有这里的办公室都装了一个！

source: Oh yeah! I can see us on the monitor!
translation: 哦，对！我能在显示器上看到我们！

source: We made it where only admins can access the footage, and only you and Sir Goro have those accounts for now.
translation: 我们设置成只有管理员能访问录像，而目前只有你和 Goro先生 有那些账号。

source: It’s password protected too, so you don’t have to worry about anyone else sneaking a peek!
translation: 它也受密码保护，所以你不用担心其他人会偷偷看一眼！

source: Like it? I came up with it myself!
translation: 喜欢吗？我自己想出来的！

source: O-Obviously…
translation: 显、显然……

source: You can always change it later…!
translation: 之后你随时可以改掉……！

source: Alright! Good job, you two! That’s a huge task off your to-do list!
translation: 好！干得好，你们两个！这就从待办清单上划掉一项大任务了！

source: Thank you! There’s gonna be another batch of cameras to install in the spring when they finish the expansion site.
translation: 谢谢！等扩建场地完成后，春天还会有另一批摄像头要安装。

source: But for the rest of the winter, it’ll most likely be web design work for me!
translation: 但冬天剩下的时间里，对我来说很可能就是网页设计工作了！

source: Yeah. That sounds perfect!
translation: 是啊。听起来完美！

source: Oh, I almost forgot to ask… How are the other departments doing?
translation: 哦，我差点忘了问……其他部门怎么样？

source: Everything’s going smoothly! I did a quick patrol around the camp too just to be sure!
translation: 一切都很顺利！为了确定，我还快速巡查了营地！

source: Still no sign of Dad?
translation: 还是没有爸爸的消息？

source: No, unfortunately. But luckily, I’ve been able to handle everything so far!
translation: 没有，很遗憾。但幸运的是，到目前为止我一直能处理好一切！

source: *sigh* I’m sorry Dad suddenly went missing. I thought he was way past his habit of doing things on his own without telling anyone.
translation: *叹气* 对不起，爸爸突然不见了。我还以为他早就改掉了瞒着任何人、独自做事的习惯。

source: And I’m shocked he picked an important day like this of all days…
translation: 而且我很震惊他偏偏挑了这样重要的一天……

source: It’s alright. I’m sure he had a good reason! We’ll keep everything in place until he comes back.
translation: 没关系。我相信他有充分理由！在他回来前，我们会把一切维持好。

source: Speaking of which, I’ll get some admin work done too!
translation: 说到这个，我也去完成一些行政工作！

source: There must be a new wave of e-mails we need to respond to! Do you mind if I use the computer, Jin?
translation: 一定有新一批邮件需要回复！Jin，你介意我使用电脑吗？

source: S-Sure…! Here you go.
translation: 当、当然……！给你。

source: By the way, I forgot to mention, but this might be relevant… Mr. Clermont called me a while ago…
translation: 顺便说一句，我忘了提，但这可能相关……Clermont先生 刚才给我打过电话……

source: Mr. Clermont…? That’s odd.
translation: Clermont先生……？真奇怪。

source: Y-Yeah, it freaked me out a little… I thought I might’ve been in trouble or something…
translation: 是、是啊，这让我有点害怕……我以为自己可能惹上麻烦了……

source: What did he tell you? Did he need anything?
translation: 他告诉你什么了？他需要什么吗？

source: Well… He was actually looking for Sir Goro. He said that he couldn’t contact him this morning…
translation: 嗯……他其实在找 Goro先生。他说今天早上联系不上 Goro先生……

source: What…? Even Mr. Clermont can’t reach him?
translation: 什么……？就连 Clermont先生 也联系不上他？

source: Do you guys think there’s something wrong…?
translation: 你们觉得是不是出了什么事……？

source: He wasn’t answering my calls this morning either… I’m starting to get worried…
translation: 他今天早上也没有接我的电话……我开始担心了……

source: Did Mr. Clermont say anything else to you…?
translation: Clermont先生 还对你说了别的吗……？

source: W-Well… He kept mentioning an email Sir Goro sent him this morning… I couldn’t really follow since I didn’t know the full story.
translation: 嗯、嗯……他一直提到 Goro先生 今天早上发给他的一封邮件……因为我不知道全部情况，实在没能听懂。

source: Yoshi! You’re in the emails now, right? Can you check that out for us?
translation: Yoshi！你现在正在看邮件，对吧？能帮我们查一下吗？

source: Yoshi, are you listening?!
translation: Yoshi，你在听吗？！

source: A-Ah! S-Sorry, Yuri… I…
translation: 啊、啊！对、对不起，Yuri……我……

source: What happened…? You look like you’ve seen a ghost...
translation: 发生什么了……？你看起来像见了鬼……

source: I just got caught off guard by what I read…
translation: 我只是被看到的内容打了个措手不及……

source: W-Well… It’s about the offer Mr. Clermont gave Goro yesterday. He wants to reopen the other branches of Camp Buddy…
translation: 嗯、嗯……这是关于昨天 Clermont先生 给 Goro 的提议。他想重新开放 Camp Buddy 的其他分部……

source: What?! Reopen?! OMG!
translation: 什么？！重新开放？！天啊！

source: That’s big news! This is probably what Mr. Clermont was talking about on our call…
translation: 这是大消息！这大概就是 Clermont先生 在我们通话里说的事……

source: How come Dad didn’t tell us about it?! This is like the biggest offer we’ve ever received!
translation: 爸爸为什么没告诉我们？！这就像我们收到过的最大提议！

source: Even bigger than the sponsorship!
translation: 甚至比赞助还大！

source: A-Actually… He told me yesterday after Mr. Clermont left…
translation: 其、其实……Clermont先生 离开后，他昨天告诉过我……

source: Oh, so you knew about this! You two are being secretive now, huh?!
translation: 哦，所以你知道这事！你们两个现在开始保密了，是吗？！

source: N-No, Yuri! That’s all I know… and that he didn’t give an answer right away.
translation: 不、不是，Yuri！我只知道这些……还有他没有立刻给出答复。

source: But seeing this… I don’t understand why Goro left out something so important…
translation: 但看到这个……我不明白 Goro 为什么遗漏了这么重要的事……

source: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什么意思？

source: With the offer, everything here at this branch would remain the same and Goro would still be the leader, but…
translation: 按照这个提议，这个分部的一切会保持不变，Goro 仍会是领导者，但是……

source: For the new branch, Mr. Clermont wants me… to be the president.
translation: 至于新分部，Clermont先生 想让我……当营地负责人。

source: Oh my god, Yoshi!!! I’m sooo happy for you! Isn’t this your dream?!
translation: 天啊，Yoshi！！！我真为你高兴！这不是你的梦想吗？！

source: Wow… Mr. Clermont is really going all out on Camp Buddy…
translation: 哇……Clermont先生这次为了Camp Buddy真是下了血本……

source: N-Not to rain on everyone’s parade, but…
translation: 不、不是要扫大家的兴，但是……

source: Apparently, Goro already sent a reply this morning…
translation: 显然，Goro 今天早上已经发出回复……

source: He turned down the offer.
translation: 他拒绝了提议。

source: WHAT?!
translation: 什么？！

source: H-Huh?! B-But, why?!
translation: 啊、啊？！但、但是，为什么？！

source: I… I’m just as shocked as you guys…
translation: 我……我和你们一样震惊……

source: No, no, no… You can’t be serious! Why would he turn down something we’ve all been working so hard for?!
translation: 不，不，不……你不是认真的！他为什么要拒绝我们都如此努力争取的东西？！

source: I don’t understand either… I thought he’d at least ask my opinion about it…
translation: 我也不明白……我以为他至少会问问我的意见……

source: Especially since I thought I was doing so much better working alongside him…
translation: 尤其是我以为和他一起工作时，自己做得好得多……

source: Th-This really doesn’t make sense… I always thought Sir Goro wanted the camp to grow…
translation: 这、这真的说不通……我一直以为 Goro先生 想让营地发展……

source: What was he thinking..? There’s literally nothing to lose here…!
translation: 他在想什么……？这里完全没有什么可失去的……！

source: This is like… a life-changing opportunity, not only for the camp, but for you, Yoshi!
translation: 这就像……改变人生的机会，不仅对营地如此，对你也是，Yoshi！

source: This is like… a life-changing opportunity, not only for the camp, but for you, Yoshi!{fast}
translation: 这就像……改变人生的机会，不仅对营地如此，对你也是，Yoshi！{fast}

source: Maybe he thinks I’m not ready…
translation: 也许他觉得我还没准备好……

source: Maybe he thinks I’m not ready for it…
translation: 也许他觉得我还没准备好面对它……

source: What?! But everyone knows you’re the best candidate for the job…!
translation: 什么？！但每个人都知道你是这份工作的最佳人选……！

source: Something’s not adding up here… I think the only way to know is to ask Dad directly…
translation: 这里有些不对劲……我想唯一能知道的办法就是直接问爸爸……

source: He knows what’s best for the camp.
translation: 他知道什么对营地最好。

source: Maybe this is for the best…
translation: 也许这是最好的……

source: There's no way to know.
translation: 没有办法知道。

source: There’s no way to know unless we ask Goro himself…
translation: 除非我们亲自问 Goro，否则没有办法知道……

source: Y-Yeah… Something’s not adding up here…
translation: 是、是啊……这里有些不对劲……

source: There must be a reason.
translation: 一定有原因。

source: There must be a reason he made this decision…
translation: 他做出这个决定一定有原因……

source: The only way we’ll know is if we ask Goro directly…
translation: 我们唯一能知道的办法就是直接问 Goro……

source: Sorry for barging in, but the materials just arrived, Yoshi!
translation: 抱歉突然闯进来，但材料刚到了，Yoshi！

source: Ah, right…!
We can take care of this later, guys. Let me know if Goro calls back.
translation: 各位，我们之后再处理这件事。如果 Goro 回电话了，告诉我。

source: Alright, Yoshi…
translation: 好的，Yoshi……

source: Let’s go, Lloyd.
translation: 走吧，Lloyd。

source: Dad…
translation: 爸爸……

source: I think that’s the last sack. We can take it from here.
translation: 我想那是最后一袋。接下来交给我们吧。

source: Thanks again for helping us take care of the deliveries today, Yoshi!
translation: 再次感谢你今天帮我们处理送货，Yoshi！

source: We’ll head back to the site and put these in temporary storage while there’s still daylight!
translation: 趁天还亮着，我们会回到现场，把这些放进临时仓库！

source: Sure thing, Lloyd.
translation: 当然，Lloyd。

source: Are you alright, Yoshi? You seem uneasy.
translation: 你没事吧，Yoshi？你看起来不安。

source: A-Ah…! I’m fine!
translation: 啊、啊……！我没事！

source: Give yourself a break, Yoshi. You’ve been handling everything all day.
translation: 让自己休息一下，Yoshi。你一整天都在处理所有事。

source: Th-Thanks. You guys can go ahead, I’ll catch up.
translation: 谢、谢谢。你们先走吧，我会跟上。

source: Umm… Alright…!
See you inside, Yoshi.
translation: 里面见，Yoshi。

source: {i}(Looking up at Camp Buddy’s arch... We’ve really come a long way since that first term…){/i}
translation: {i}（抬头看着 Camp Buddy 的拱门……自从第一期以来，我们真的走了很远……）{/i}

source: {i}(It’s been my dream to work here and see the camp grow. And I always believed Goro thought the same.){/i}
translation: {i}（在这里工作、看着营地成长，一直是我的梦想。我也一直相信 Goro 有同样的想法。）{/i}

source: {i}(I can think of a lot of reasons why he might turn down an opportunity like this but… what’s he thinking?){/i}
translation: {i}（我能想到许多他可能拒绝这种机会的理由，但是……他在想什么？）{/i}

source: {i}(I really need to know…){/i}
translation: {i}（我真的需要知道……）{/i}

source: Wh-What’s that sound…?
translation: 那、那是什么声音……？

source: G-Goro?!
translation: G-Goro？！

source: I’m back, Yoshinori. Were you waiting for me?
translation: 我回来了，Yoshinori。你在等我吗？

source: Y-Yeah…! I’ve been looking for you all day.
translation: 是、是啊……！我找了你一整天。

source: I know I left without telling anyone, but I wanted to surprise you.
translation: 我知道自己没告诉任何人就离开了，但我想给你一个惊喜。

source: We couldn’t contact you, and we were all getting worried...
translation: 我们联系不上你，大家都开始担心了……

source: Ah, sorry about that. I couldn’t answer my phone while I was driving.
translation: 啊，抱歉。我开车时没法接电话。

source: Wh-Where have you been?
translation: 你、你去了哪里？

source: Well, I got caught up with a lot of things… but mostly, I got this bad boy back from my friend.
translation: 嗯，我忙了很多事情……但主要是，我从朋友那里拿回了这个大家伙。

source: It’s been well-maintained even after all these years, but I still had it outfitted and tuned up to be ready for tonight.
translation: 这么多年后它依然保养得很好，但我还是为它装配并调校了一番，准备今晚使用。

source: Pretty slick, huh?
translation: 很帅气，对吧？

source: Well, what are you waiting for? Let’s ride!
translation: 嗯，你还在等什么？我们去骑吧！

source: Well, what are you waiting for? Let’s ride!{fast}
translation: 嗯，你还在等什么？我们去骑吧！{fast}

source: What about the camp?
translation: 那营地怎么办？

source: Wh-What about the camp…?
translation: 营、营地怎么办……？

source: Don’t worry about it. I already texted Yuri that we’re headed out.
translation: 别担心。我已经发消息告诉 Yuri 我们出发了。

source: We're going out?
translation: 我们要出去？

source: W-We’re going out…?
translation: 我、我们要出去……？

source: Don’t worry about the camp, I already texted Yuri that we’re headed out.
translation: 别担心营地，我已经发消息告诉 Yuri 我们出发了。

source: What's going on?
translation: 怎么回事？

source: What’s going on? This is all too sudden…
translation: 怎么回事？这一切太突然了……

source: You’ll find out.
translation: 你会知道的。

source: Where are you taking me?
translation: 你要带我去哪里？

source: Wh-Where are you taking me?
translation: 你、你要带我去哪里？

source: I don’t want to spoil it. Just come with me.
translation: 我不想剧透。跟我来就好。

source: Here, wear this.
translation: 来，穿上这个。

source: *throws jacket to Yoshinori*
translation: *把夹克扔给 Yoshinori*

source: A-Alright…!
Let’s go.
translation: 走吧。

source: {i}I was so caught off guard by Goro’s sudden appearance, I didn’t even have time to ask him about the offer…{/i}
translation: {i}Goro 突然出现让我措手不及，我甚至没时间问他那个提议的事……{/i}

source: {i}He was acting strangely, but he didn’t seem upset… I wonder where he’s taking me…{/i}
translation: {i}他的举止很奇怪，但看起来并不难过……我想知道他要带我去哪里……{/i}

source: You holdin’ up ok back there, Yoshinori?
translation: 你在后面还撑得住吗，Yoshinori？

source: Y-Yeah…!
translation: 是、是啊……！

source: How’s the ride so far? Hope you’re enjoying it~!
translation: 到目前为止骑得怎么样？希望你喜欢～！

source: I-It’s thrilling…! But I’m kinda scared that we’ll crash at the speed we’re going…!
translation: 很、很刺激……！但按我们这个速度，我有点害怕会撞车……！

source: This isn’t fast at all, hahaha! And trust me, I rode through way worse than this back in my day! I’ve still got the skills to handle it!
translation: 这根本不快，哈哈哈！相信我，我当年骑过比这糟糕得多的路况！我依然有本事应付！

source: B-But the roads can get icy too…!
translation: 但、但是路面也会结冰……！

source: It’s not as cold today, so don’t worry ‘cause I fitted this bad boy out with some winter tires, so we’re covered!
translation: 今天没那么冷，所以别担心，因为我给这个大家伙装了冬季轮胎，我们没问题！

source: I didn’t know you were such a daredevil, Goro…! We didn’t even put helmets on! We might not make it back home alive at this rate…!
translation: 我不知道你这么大胆，Goro……！我们甚至没戴头盔！照这样下去，我们可能活着回不了家……！

source: Hahaha! It’s not really that far of a ride, we should be fine!
translation: 哈哈哈！这段路其实不远，我们应该没问题！

source: You still haven’t told me where we’re going.
translation: 你还是没告诉我要去哪里。

source: Just wait, and you’ll see!
translation: 等着看就好！

source: *sigh* Okay…
translation: *叹气* 好吧……

source: {i}(I’ve never seen Goro this excited before… He seems to be really happy that we’re riding together.){/i}
translation: {i}（我以前从没见过 Goro 这么兴奋……他似乎真的很高兴能和我一起骑车。）{/i}

source: {i}(It makes me feel guilty that I can’t get what I found out earlier off my mind…){/i}
translation: {i}（我无法把早些时候发现的事从脑海中赶走，这让我感到愧疚……）{/i}

source: So, how did things go back at camp while I was gone?
translation: 那么，我不在时营地的情况怎么样？

source: W-Well, the workers came back so it got quite busy…
translation: 嗯、嗯，工人们回来了，所以变得相当忙……

source: Ah, shit… I completely forgot that was today.
translation: 啊，该死……我完全忘了那是今天。

source: Ah, shit… I completely forgot that was today.{fast}
translation: 啊，该死……我完全忘了那是今天。{fast}

source: I could’ve used your help.
translation: 我本可以用上你的帮助。

source: I managed to get things moving, but… I could’ve really used your help.
translation: 我设法让事情运转起来，但是……我真的本可以用上你的帮助。

source: Ah, I’m sorry about that… and for going out without telling you.
translation: 啊，我对此很抱歉……也为没告诉你就出去道歉。

source: I didn’t mean to neglect work today. I just had something really important to take care of.
translation: 我不是有意忽视今天的工作。我只是有件非常重要的事要处理。

source: I-I see…
translation: 我、我明白了……

source: That’s not like you at all.
translation: 这完全不像你。

source: Th-That’s not like you at all, Goro…
translation: 这、这完全不像你，Goro……

source: Ah… I know. I’m sorry for going out without telling you.
translation: 啊……我知道。对不起，我没告诉你就出去了。

source: I took care of it.
translation: 我已经处理好了。

source: D-Don’t worry…! I took care of it.
translation: 别、别担心……！我已经处理好了。

source: Ah, that’s good to know.
translation: 啊，知道这个就好。

source: I’m really sorry for going out without telling you.
translation: 我真的很抱歉，没告诉你就出去了。

source: Everything’s under control.
translation: 一切都在控制之中。

source: I had everything under control, though…! Everyone got back to work pretty smoothly.
translation: 不过我已经把一切控制好了……！大家很顺利地回去工作了。

source: Ah, I’m glad you took care of things.
translation: 啊，我很高兴你处理好了事情。

source: You did a great job, Yoshinori. You’ve always been an amazing leader, and I’m really proud of you.
translation: 你做得很棒，Yoshinori。你一直都是出色的领导者，我真的为你骄傲。

source: {i}(Hearing Goro acknowledge me like that made me even more confused… I don’t know why he’d say that after what he told Mr. Clermont…){/i}
translation: {i}（听到 Goro 那样肯定我，让我更加困惑……我不知道他在对 Clermont先生 说了那些话之后，为什么还会这么说……）{/i}

source: Ah, we’re going into the woods soon so it’s gonna be a little rocky!
translation: 啊，我们很快要进森林了，所以路会有点颠！

source: Hold tight, Yoshinori!
translation: 抓紧，Yoshinori！

source: You alright, Yoshinori?
translation: 你还好吗，Yoshinori？

source: Y-Yeah… just a little nauseous from the bumpy ride. I didn’t think you were serious about driving on a snowy dirt path.
translation: 是、是啊……只是颠簸的车程让我有点恶心。我没想到你真会在积雪的土路上开车。

source: Sorry I had to take that detour. It’s the only route available to reach this place by motorcycle.
translation: 抱歉我不得不绕这条路。这是骑摩托车到达这个地方唯一可走的路线。

source: Wait a minute… This is…
translation: 等一下……这里是……

source: Buddy Falls. I figured I’d show you how beautiful it is during the winter…
translation: Buddy 瀑布。我想让你看看它在冬天有多美……

source: The surface of the pool is frozen, but the falls themselves are still flowing so calmly.
translation: 水潭表面结冰了，但瀑布本身仍然如此平静地流淌。

source: Yeah, it’s so pretty… In all my years at camp, I’ve never seen it like this.
translation: 是啊，太漂亮了……我在营地这么多年，从没见过它这个样子。

source: We only ever camp here on special occasions, after all…
translation: 毕竟，我们只会在特殊场合来这里露营……

source: Yes. But we’re not camping here tonight. I brought you here for something else…
translation: 是的。但我们今晚不是来这里露营。我带你来是为了别的事……

source: Wh-What is it…?
translation: 是、是什么……？

source: Come with me, it’s almost time.
translation: 跟我来，快到时候了。

source: Wh-Where to?
translation: 去、去哪里？

source: Take my hand. It’s best if I just show you.
translation: 牵我的手。我直接给你看最好。

source: {i}Taking Goro’s hand, we hiked our way to the top of the falls as the sun continued to set.{/i}
translation: {i}牵着 Goro 的手，我们趁着太阳继续落下，一路徒步到瀑布顶端。{/i}

source: W-Wow…!!
Heh… Amazing isn’t it…?
translation: 呵……很惊人，对吧……？

source: Y-Yeah… I’ve never seen it this beautiful before!
translation: 是、是啊……我以前从没见过它这么美！

source: We’re lucky we caught the aurora in time… It’s pretty rare to spot it so clearly like this…
translation: 我们很幸运及时看到了极光……像这样清楚地看到它相当罕见……

source: Is this what you wanted to show me…?
translation: 这就是你想给我看的东西……？

source: Yes. But more than that, this place is very special to me.
translation: 是的。但更重要的是，这个地方对我非常特别。

source: This is exactly where we made our promise way back then... at the end of the very first term.
translation: 这里正是很久以前我们许下承诺的地方……就在第一期结束时。

source: I… I remember…
translation: 我……我记得……

source: My life has completely changed since then… It marked a new beginning for me…
translation: 从那以后，我的人生完全改变了……那标志着我的新开始……

source: You set out to become a scoutmaster, and I couldn’t have been happier to have someone else share my dream for Camp Buddy.
translation: 你踏上成为童子军团长的路，而能有其他人和我分享对 Camp Buddy 的梦想，我再开心不过。

source: You gave me hope when I thought everything was failing in my life… A second chance at happiness…
translation: 当我以为人生中的一切都在失败时，你给了我希望……给了我第二次获得幸福的机会……

source: Wh-What’s the matter, Yoshinori…?
translation: 怎、怎么了，Yoshinori……？

source: I-I’m just so confused, Goro…
translation: 我、我只是太困惑了，Goro……

source: While you were gone today, I found out that you turned down the offer for Camp Buddy…
translation: 今天你不在时，我发现你拒绝了给 Camp Buddy 的提议……

source: I just thought that… you would at least talk to me about it first…
translation: 我只是以为……你至少会先和我谈谈……

source: I-I’m sorry, Yoshinori… I was planning on telling you all along…
translation: 我、我很抱歉，Yoshinori……我本来一直打算告诉你……

source: I-I’m sorry, Yoshinori… I was planning on telling you all along…{fast}
translation: 我、我很抱歉，Yoshinori……我本来一直打算告诉你……{fast}

source: I thought you believed in me…
translation: 我以为你相信我……

source: I thought you believed in me, Goro…
translation: 我以为你相信我，Goro……

source: All this time, you’ve been telling me how much I’ve grown as a scoutmaster and a future leader.
translation: 一直以来，你都在告诉我，作为童子军团长和未来领导者，我成长了多少。

source: To think that you turned down the biggest opportunity we’ve ever had without me knowing…
translation: 想到你在我不知情的情况下拒绝了我们曾有过的最大机会……

source: It really feels like you don’t think I’m cut out for it at all…
translation: 这真的让我觉得你根本不认为我适合这件事……

source: I thought you could rely on me…
translation: 我以为你可以依靠我……

source: I thought you could rely on me, Goro…
translation: 我以为你可以依靠我，Goro……

source: All this time, we opened up to each other and did everything together…
translation: 一直以来，我们彼此敞开心扉，一起做所有事情……

source: It really feels like you don’t trust me at all…
translation: 这真的让我觉得你根本不信任我……

source: I need to understand why…
translation: 我需要理解为什么……

source: This is the biggest opportunity we’ve ever had, and I thought it was your dream…
translation: 这是我们曾有过的最大机会，我以为这就是你的梦想……

source: I really thought I knew you well enough by now, but I can’t figure this out…
translation: 我真的以为自己现在已经足够了解你，但我想不明白这件事……

source: I just need to understand why, Goro…
translation: 我只是需要理解为什么，Goro……

source: We’re in this together…
translation: 我们是一起面对这件事的……

source: I’ve always believed that we’re in this together, Goro… We’re partners, aren’t we?
translation: 我一直相信我们是一起面对这件事的，Goro……我们是伙伴，不是吗？

source: I apologize, Yoshinori…
translation: 我向你道歉，Yoshinori……

source: I understand why you’re upset, and you have every right to be.
translation: 我理解你为什么难过，而且你完全有理由这样。

source: It was wrong of me to make such a huge decision on my own…
translation: 我独自做出这么重大的决定是错的……
